operation: read-only remote aggregation; no simulation/replay; no raw artifact transfer
pressure_controller_status: PP and MP use no learned override audit and are not included in execution_summary.csv; missing rates are not zero.
denominator: All post-warmup intersection-by-decision-epoch decisions in the guard audit, summed within method and city; 79,296 for Los Angeles and 713,664 for Jinan.
effective_override: A learned-reference disagreement that becomes an executor-accepted switch request or an effective hold of the current green. These counters record accepted requests and effective holds, not completed green-phase changes.
guard_rejections: Sum of rejected_* counters excluding rejected_cooldown, rejected_coordination, and rejected_executor; in these data, nonzero guard counters are confidence and service-safety checks.
accounting: decisions = model-reference agreements + guard rejections + proposed overrides; proposed overrides = effective overrides + cooldown + spatial + executor rejections.
rates: All percentage columns divide the corresponding summed count by post_warmup_intersection_decisions and multiply by 100. These are not per-run mean rates or percentages conditional on disagreement.
trace_warning: Do not derive execution rates from accepted_intervention_trace length; traces can be capped and can include ineffective requests. Rates here use complete guard counters.
interpretation: Jinan CFCMT accepts one non-reference switch request in 713,664 decisions; the archived result describes a nearly reference-following controller. Learned-intervention benefit is not isolated without the exact standalone generalized-pressure reference.
per_run_provenance: execution_rollouts.csv retains method, city, scenario, seed, archived result_path and every integer guard counter; pressure-policy guard fields are empty.
